outro.cta: New AI + code videos every week.

scenes.voiceover: The Content Factory is officially online. An entire video studio, compiled from code.
Every video starts as a JSON script. Scenes, voiceover, visuals. React components compile it into the finished video, frame by frame.
One command runs the whole pipeline. Voice, captions, code animation, and both aspect ratios, rendered without opening a single editor.
The trend radar watches the entire developer internet, so the next video idea finds us before anyone else covers it.
Almost everything here is automated. Quiz shorts, one hundred percent. Data stories, ninety five. The news format, ninety. Humans keep the last mile.
scenes.label: Automation level by format

scenes.voiceover: Automation does not replace creators. It multiplies them.
scenes.quote: Automation doesn't replace creators. It multiplies them.

scenes.voiceover: And yes. The render farm is already asking for overtime pay.
